Animals, recording scope and earlier study records

The study reports 51 Shox2 reporter mice and 6 Chx10 reporter mice. Individual cell-to-animal assignments and individual cell ages are unavailable in these summary tables. Sex is not stated in the retained article methods.

Sixty Shox2 recordings from 28 of the Shox2 mice were included from an earlier study. They remain a subset of the present analysis pool.

The article's reporter-by-firing counts describe this same recording pool:

Tonic · Shox2: 78 recorded observations
Tonic · Chx10: 10 recorded observations
Initial doublet · Shox2: 36 recorded observations
Initial doublet · Chx10: 13 recorded observations
Initial burst · Shox2: 21 recorded observations
Initial burst · Chx10: 3 recorded observations
Delay · Shox2: 8 recorded observations
Delay · Chx10: 2 recorded observations

Transverse adult-lumbar spinal slices; whole-cell patch clamp at room temperature. Age and lumbar level describe the study; physiological group labels remain analytical groupings.

These are published aggregate electrophysiology summaries and study-local classification methods. No cell-level roster, raw trace, morphology, atlas placement, molecular equivalence, synapse or internal structure is admitted.

Source statements and interpretation limits

Cm = Rin/τ · The printed expression is retained as source text. The adapter uses the published table summaries and performs no capacitance calculation or silent formula correction.

The source k-group positive counts list four observations whereas six positive observations are reported; no missing group/cell assignment is inferred.

The clustering results remain study-local physiology context, with no mapping to the molecular profiles or morphology records in this app.
